preconditions.description: K must be between 1 and the length of the string S.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of lowercase alphabets.
The length of the string S must not exceed 100,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of substrings of length K with exactly K-1 distinct characters.
